name: HEALTHBANE Campaign ATT&CK Mapping
description: Observed and inferred MITRE ATT&CK techniques for the HEALTHBANE campaign targeting healthcare entities.

techniques.comment: OBSERVED: Delivery of malicious PDF invoices via email.
OBSERVED: Spearphishing links pointing to fraudulent credential harvesting portals.
INFERRED: Broad sector-wide automated phishing distribution.
OBSERVED: Users opening PDF attachments and clicking embedded URI links.
INFERRED: Execution of helper scripts following document engagement.
OBSERVED: Phishing pages designed to harvest staff usernames and passwords.
INFERRED: Acquisition of credential harvesting frameworks and templates.
INFERRED: Potential follow-up session token hijacking on fake SSO portals.
OBSERVED: Obfuscated URI actions and redirect links within PDF object streams.
OBSERVED: HTTPS beaconing to C2 domains and external VPS infrastructure.
INFERRED: Standard TLS encryption utilized for C2 and exfiltration channels.
OBSERVED: Outbound transmission of harvested credentials and billing data.
